title: window_detection.json
description: One entry per instant model and window model. Each holds what the alarm on every tick caught with the window model's alarm added, keyed by k, when k of the last `n` rows raise the alarm on every tick. The window model flags the last row of each window whose score is above its threshold, and alarms where k of the last `n` rows are flagged. Compare each k with the same model's entry in the test run's `detection.json`.

instant.description: The instant model, with the threshold calibrate gave it.

window.description: The window model, with the threshold calibrate_windows gave it.
